objective: Implement deterministic point-in-time liquidity heatmap and displayed-capacity analytics from governed P09-D order-book snapshots without converting displayed depth into execution guarantees.
scope: Define governed liquidity heatmap policy with explicit strictly increasing distance bands
Aggregate displayed bid/ask size and price-times-size notional into symmetric midpoint distance bands
Compute deterministic cumulative displayed capacity within each configured distance threshold
Compute deterministic bid/ask displayed-capacity shares in basis points
Retain provider, venue, source-kind, coverage scope and source snapshot identity
Fail closed on invalid band geometry, empty in-scope heatmap or invalid P09-D order book
Preserve spot-FX broker/ECN/provider scope inherited from P09-D
out_of_scope: Cross-provider or global spot-FX liquidity synthesis
Funding, Open Interest, liquidation or crowding models (P09-F)
Signal fusion, calibrated trade probability, Risk approval or broker/exchange execution
dependencies: Fresh Live Guard: open PRs 0, active task none, active lock none
tests: Strict Pyright passes for P09 liquidity heatmap source
Heatmap policy requires strictly increasing positive band thresholds
P09-D order-book integrity and point-in-time validation is inherited
Each displayed book level is assigned to at most one non-cumulative distance band
Cumulative displayed size and notional are deterministic
Capacity-share basis points are deterministic, bounded and sum to 10000
No in-scope displayed liquidity within the maximum band fails closed
Spot-FX provider scope remains enforced through P09-D validation
Heatmap identity is deterministic and content/policy-sensitive
Heatmap contracts expose no fillability/slippage/order/recommendation authority
P09-E evidence is byte-identical across two runs
security_tests: No broker/exchange execution adapter is imported
No credential or network access is required
No hidden liquidity or cross-provider global liquidity is synthesized
rollback: Revert P09-E heatmap module, policy, tests, evidence/CI wiring and active-state reconciliation. P09-A/B/C/D remain canonical and no production/trading state changes.
definition_of_done: Liquidity heatmap and displayed-capacity contracts implemented
Distance-band, cumulative-capacity and provenance invariants enforced
Deterministic evidence and strict CI pass
Post-merge Governance and Branch Hygiene pass
